cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.18)
project(ryeenzyxnz CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

# overlay_dex.h is generated by module/build.sh (javac + d8) into ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/gen
include_directories(${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/gen)

# APK payload -> libryeenzyxnz.so, injected into Roblox's arm64 split APK by tools/patch_roblox.py
add_library(ryeenzyxnz_payload SHARED payload.cpp jvm_boot.cpp hook.cpp glhooks.cpp trace.cpp dpipe.cpp fxrt.cpp effects.cpp core.cpp)
set_target_properties(ryeenzyxnz_payload PROPERTIES OUTPUT_NAME ryeenzyxnz LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/payload)
target_compile_options(ryeenzyxnz_payload PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -fvisibility=hidden)
target_link_libraries(ryeenzyxnz_payload PRIVATE log EGL GLESv3 dl)
# 16 KB page-size compatible (Android 15+); static STL so no libc++_shared.so is needed at load time
target_link_options(ryeenzyxnz_payload PRIVATE -Wl,-z,max-page-size=16384 -Wl,--build-id)
